items.titleZh: 诺里斯帮助科拉平托进入第7圈
items.summaryZh: 诺里斯在墨西哥大奖赛中帮助科拉平托进入第7圈，由于脱离气流后速度下降，他不得不在刹车中完成这一操作。
items.originalTitle: Norris gets Colapinto into Turn 1 for P7. He had to do it on the brakes because once he pulled out of the slipstream he stopped gaining on the Alpine ...
items.summaryEn: Norris gets Colapinto into Turn 1 for P7. He had to do it on the brakes because once he pulled out of the slipstream he stopped gaining on the Alpine #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 诺里斯帮助科拉平托进入第1个弯道，排名第7。他不得不在刹车中完成这个动作，因为他一旦脱离了气流，就不再能追上阿尔法·罗密欧F1墨西哥大奖赛的车队
detailEn: Norris gets Colapinto into Turn 1 for P7. He had to do it on the brakes because once he pulled out of the slipstream he stopped gaining on the Alpine #F1 #MexicoGP

items.summaryZh: stewards 正在调查汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔在墨西哥大奖赛中的碰撞，勒克莱尔目前领先，维斯塔潘超越汉密尔顿升至第二，安东内利升至第四位领先拉塞尔。
items.originalTitle: This is under investigation by the stewards. It'll depend on whether Hamilton forced both of them wide or Leclerc was never making the corner #F1 #Mex...
items.summaryEn:
This is under investigation by the stewards. It'll depend on whether Hamilton forced both of them wide or Leclerc was never making the corner #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Hamilton and Leclerc tangle at Turn 4! Leclerc now leads but cut the corner, Verstappen passes Hamilton for P2!
Antonelli is up to P4 ahead of Russell! #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 这是由裁判组正在调查的事情。这取决于汉密尔顿是否迫使他们都开到了外侧，还是勒克莱尔从未成功过弯 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛Chris Medland：汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔在4号弯发生碰撞！勒克莱尔现在领先，但切了弯，维斯塔潘超越汉密尔顿，升至第二！安东内利升至第四，领先拉塞尔！#F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
This is under investigation by the stewards. It'll depend on whether Hamilton forced both of them wide or Leclerc was never making the corner #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Hamilton and Leclerc tangle at Turn 4! Leclerc now leads but cut the corner, Verstappen passes Hamilton for P2!
Antonelli is up to P4 ahead of Russell! #F1 #MexicoGP
